_comment: A piece is a PARTIAL settings document in the child's own JSON format. It is
never a whole settings file: a piece that sets one key contains only that key.
Pieces are composed in the order a profile lists them; see docs/reference/configuration.md.
Copy this to a name of your choosing under the pieces directory and edit it there:
The wrapper never writes your configuration. It reads pieces and composes them
into the generated settings file inside the isolated session directory.
This file is HAND-MAINTAINED, unlike the other examples in this directory. A
piece has no wrapper-side type to reflect over, because its shape belongs to the
child and evolves on the child's schedule. Keys below are illustrative only:
the wrapper does not validate unknown piece keys, it forwards them.
Every value is a placeholder. Replace or delete before use.
This _comment key is itself illustrative. JSON has no comment syntax, so a piece
that needs annotation carries it in a key the child ignores - or, better, keeps
the annotation out of the file entirely.
